rulings.q: What does an "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" effect do?
rulings.a: It increases the maximum value described in "delete Digimon with DP X000 or less" effects. For example, while "[Your Turn] Add 1000 to the maximum DP you can choose with DP-based deletion effects" is active, "[When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less" will allow you to delete an opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

rulings.q: If "add X000 to the maximum your DP-based deletion effects can delete" is active, can the maximum be increased for an effect such as "delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP" that references a Digimon's DP for deletion?
rulings.a: No, it can't be increased. You can't increase the maximum of a DP-based deletion effect that doesn't show a numerical value.

rulings.q: Does a "may digivolve this card as if the Tamer is a Digimon" effect also treat the Tamer that will become a digivolution card as a Digimon when it digivolves?
rulings.a: Yes, it also treats the Tamer as a Digimon when it digivolves. It treats it as a Digimon that digivolves, therefore "when a Digimon would digivolve" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects will trigger. In addition, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect activates, digivolution won't be possible using this effect that also treats the Tamer as a Digimon.

rulings.q: Is a digivolution bonus draw performed even when a Tamer digivolves?
rulings.a: Yes, you perform a digivolution bonus draw. A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.

rulings.q: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack in the same turn?
rulings.a: No, it can't. Even if a card digivolves from a card that was placed on the field in the same turn, it can't attack during that turn. It can only attack in the turns after it's played.

rulings.q: Does a Tamer card placed under a Digimon become a digivolution card?
rulings.a: Yes, it becomes a digivolution card. If that Digimon would leave the field, the Tamer card will be trashed like a normal digivolution card.

rulings.q: Does a Digimon gain the Security effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
rulings.a: No, it doesn't.

rulings.q: Does a Digimon gain the Inherited effect in the lower text on a Tamer card in digivolution cards?
rulings.a: Yes, it does.

rulings.q: Can I choose to not digivolve with this card's 1st effect?
rulings.a: No, you can't. For this card's 1st effect, you declare a digivolution, then upon revealing this card, you can also choose a Tamer as the card to digivolve, and that Tamer is also treated as a level 3 Digimon. As with the normal digivolution procedure, after revealing this card and declaring a digivolution, you can't choose to not digivolve. In addition, you can't declare digivolution into this card in the first place unless there is a card on the field that you can digivolve.

rulings.q: What does "effects don't affect" mean, exactly?
rulings.a: This effect prevents a card from being affected by effects. For example, your Digimon won't suspend if it's chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect, and its DP won't be reduced by 3000 if it's chosen for a "1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP" effect.

rulings.q: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be chosen for an effect?
rulings.a: Yes, it can be chosen. For example, a Digimon that isn't affected by effects can be chosen for a "suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon" effect.

rulings.q: Can a card that has an "effects don't affect" effect be given an effect?
rulings.a: Yes, it can. It won't be affected by it, but it can be given an effect. However, if an effect such as is given to a Digimon that isn't affected by effects, the Digimon won't be considered to have that effect.

rulings.q: If a card is affected by an effect, then it later gains an "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that was affecting it?
rulings.a: As soon as it gains the "effects don't affect" effect, it will no longer be affected.

rulings.q: If a card has an "effects don't affect" effect, it gains an effect, then it later loses the "effects don't affect" effect, what happens to the effect that it gained?
rulings.a: It will be affected by the effect as soon as it can be affected by effects.

rulings.q: A card that has an "effects don't affect" effect was given an effect that triggers at a timing such as [When Attacking]. Will the effect trigger if that card later meets the trigger conditions?
rulings.a: If the Digimon isn't affected by effects upon the trigger timing, the effect won't trigger.
